concepts.gloss_en: The true leader — the aspect of Moshe, the comprehensive spirit (ruach hakolel) of all Israel who apportions greatness to each person according to his level

reason_for_human: All four occurrences are in the same lesson (lm2:72) and every one explicitly equates the leader with the aspect of Moshe / ruach hakolel who distributes greatness to each person. The indefinite 'מנהיג אמתי' (occ_3882) is not a generic type contrasted with the archetype — it is the same single Mosaic leader ('who can distribute the greatness... through his gazing alone'); the definite/indefinite difference here is just grammar, not archetype-vs-generic. Merging into one concept.
